problem:
$$
v=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}],\,A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$

The vector $v$ and the matrix $A$ are given above. 
If $v$ is an eigenvector of $A$ that corresponds to the eigenvalue $\lambda =7,$ then what is the value of $\frac{b}{c}?$
